title: The Team: System Configuration → Team (Piece 2, P2-2)
why: Jason's Piece 2 (decisions/0179; handoffs/piece2-team.md, approved 2026-11-25): the roster of roles that work the Work queue, as data in System Configuration, its permissions only from Access. Nothing runs by itself: the runner comes in P2-3, on staging only. It also carries one line in the admin kit (app/admin/kit-css.php: .ak-t tr[hidden]{display:none}), so a folded group's rows stay folded on phones in every admin table; it only hides what was already meant to be hidden.
data_reason: Seeds the 33 roles of Jason's spec into the new team_roster table, once (INSERT ... WHERE NOT EXISTS): 9 working, 11 advocates, 13 on standby. Changes no existing row.

changes.what: A new Team section: the roles by department, standby folded, each role's drawer with Edit, History and its status
Access::canAs: permissions for a named level and department (the Team's agents act only through it)
On phones, a folded group's rows stay folded in every admin table
FAQ: What is the Team page?

rollback: Proved on the bench (tools/team-tests/rollback.sh, 2026-11-25): the zip laid over the live mirror (Sync 16:58 UTC) and its migrations run twice, then Roll back as the site does it (each file put back from live, the new ones removed): the files match live byte for byte, every PHP file parses, and the Work queue's own suite (work-queue.cjs, as on main) passes 84 of 84 on the rolled-back code. Left behind: the table team_roster, unused (migrations only add).
